root.statement: Every reversible identity admitted by a fixed common process account admits a source-generated marked realization with forward/reverse operations, compatible comparison through a third presentation, common rooted realization, higher-coherent return certificates and preservation of licensed dependent continuations under composition.
root.quantifier_order: First freeze source class, admission semantics, contexts/resources and continuation family independently of successful constructions; then quantify over every admitted reversible identity and seek one coherently composable realization family.
root.acceptance: Construct the realization family and its generation, full-input return, higher-coherence and continuation-preservation laws at the fixed scope.
root.rejection_condition: An admitted reversible identity has no such realization within the whole fixed source class, or the proposed family's required typed coherence/continuation law fails.
root.candidate_rejection_boundary: A failed particular implementation rejects that candidate, not every possible realization.
